caption: Yellow and red watercolour are dripped onto a wet sheet of paper, and where they run together an orange band forms.

sa.check: A wet sheet of paper is present.
Yellow and red watercolour are dripped onto it.
An orange band forms where they meet.
The drips come first and the running together follows.

pc.expect: The orange forms only where the two colours meet and spreads as they bleed; it does not retreat.
pc.fail: The orange shrinks; or the colours separate again; or orange appears where they have not met.

pc.expect: The mix is orange, and the pure yellow and red remain at the edges.
pc.fail: The mix is a colour other than orange; or the pure colours change; or the whole sheet turns one colour at once.

pc.expect: Wet watercolour bleeds and feathers on the paper.
pc.fail: It stays as hard-edged blobs; or beads up and rolls; or the paper stays dry.

pc.expect: The drops fall onto the paper and the paint runs where the paper slopes.
pc.fail: The drops rise; or the paint runs uphill; or the drops hang.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or paint appears from nowhere.

pc.expect: The paper and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The paper changes shape; or the table changes; or the dropper changes.
